notes.title: Demo version this Fall
notes.notes: [h1][b]Dear players![/b][/h1][p]Soon we will share with you the demo version of Tales of Meadows. Players will have the opportunity to take on the role of Philip for the first time, participate in a real historical battle, and immerse themselves in an epic journey full of challenges across the meadows and settlements of the ancient Principality of Turov.[/p][p]In the demo version, players will have access to two storyline locations that will kick off the story of Tales of Meadows in the full version of the game.Currently, a closed beta test is underway among our Boosty subscribers; however, this fall we will share the game with all of you![/p][p]Thank you for continuing to follow our project, for your support, and for adding us to your wishlist! It's truly incredibly important for us.[/p][previewyoutube="oZRlOn-5EWI;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h1]New Screenshots![/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45516897/fe7690e2b06acafccb9be966f23b73a68dfff881.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45516897/0cd3ee22cc801b32e828dce3119cfafe4c55396e.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45516897/7f7474947afbc6698f8e0890b71ef91778d0a6ba.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: The cinematic trailer is out!
notes.notes:
[b] Dear players! [/b]

We develop Tales of Meadows with great trepidation, giving this project a lot of strength and love. This is our first project, and therefore it is special. Creating the game on full enthusiasm, in a state of constant lack of resources, we have come a long way - from the first exhibitions, at which the working build-prototype still did not represent much and did not make much impression, to a full-fledged and loyal audience. We are grateful to each of you for following the development of the game, supporting us and motivating us.

We, the Qualestory Games team, are proud and excited to present you with our first cinematic trailer, in which we lift the veil of secrecy over the plot of the game. You can view it directly on the game page on Steam or on our YouTube channel:

[previewyoutube=ChE-dzzAGyE;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]We express special gratitude to the team, thanks to which the release of the trailer became possible:[/b]

| Cinematic Artist - Michail Hamanovich
| Voice Actor - Denis Vorontsov
| Composer - Pawel Orlow
| Writer - Vyacheslav Davidyuk
| 2D Artist - Maksim Viaroukin
